likely_cause: The platform docs say that Viewers can never write to the artifact's database, their own private data included. In the app's code, when a save is refused it keeps the session in the browser only, but on the next load the database answers normally with nothing in it, so the app shows an empty history and never looks at the browser copy. The status label says "saves: account" because it only checks that the database and the user id exist. The refused save itself was not captured (network recording started after the drill); the read on reload was captured and returned 200.
